title: Restore canonical receiving plan form and server-numbered HTTP entry
description: Make the existing receiving-plan menu use the canonical api/container/receiving-plans module instead of the blocked legacy bill family. ContainerReceivingPlan.PlanNo is Required with empty default although ContainerReceivingPlanController assigns the number. Restore genuine omitted-number creation with server-owned ID/status, typed nullable references and correct date/quantity fields; retain existing live warehouse/product/supplier validation, receiving-plan menu authority, unit/quantity bounds and lifecycle. Plans remain planning evidence and must not create actual inventory receipts, stock movements or guessed procurement/shipping references. Do not enable legacy mutation or remap old identities. Write full build/test output and TRX under .ai/logs/<task>/ with explicit --results-directory; never put generated artifacts in the repository root or stage them. Preserve all original failure logs and result files; if relocation is necessary verify exact targets stay inside the executor and copy/move completed artifacts into .ai/logs without deleting work or resetting attempts. Test API fixtures must use an ephemeral process-local cryptographic JWT key and genuine existing authentication, not production configuration or a missing-key fallback. Retain existing live identity/menu/customer-scope authority, transactions, source locks, controlled errors and audit. Reject before numbering or persistence, with zero header/detail/source/status mutations. No new permissions, schema, production access, external service or arbitrary SQL. Genuine SQL only on (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with Integrated Security and a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject wrong/existing targets and never drop/reset. Require safe Release with analyzers/warnings-as-errors, full units and relevant genuine SQL/browser tests; accurately record blockers and do not claim whole-stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Authorized receiving-plan menu opens its canonical module, omitted-number HTTP requests produce server numbers/canonical IDs, and form save/reload/edit, supported optional references and dates/quantity/unit inputs round trip correctly. Legacy read history remains separate and old writes remain fail closed.

Retain current live identity/menu/master-reference rules and draft/submit/approve/cancel restrictions. Invalid/deleted/disabled master references, invalid quantity/unit and revoked authority reject before numbering/persistence; valid plan state changes create no stock/movement/financial record or inferred source links.

Real isolated SQL/HTTP tests cover omitted-number binding, valid form/state flow, master invalidation and denied zero writes/numbering/inventory effects; browser proof must use actual API writes or record missing execution. Preserve existing lifecycle/unit tests, safe Release/full regressions and original full logs/TRX.
implementation_evidence: bill-v2.js:46 still maps receiving-plan to a legacy stored-procedure family; modules-doc2.js:136-154 already registers api/container/receiving-plans. Container1.cs:14-15 marks PlanNo Required with empty default and ContainerControllers.cs ContainerReceivingPlanController.Create uses server numbering. ERP-361 provides master/lifecycle validation but leaves menu precedence/model binding unresolved.
